Against such an enemy, excessive caution would be difficult to achieve.

I raised my sword into a high guard.

Out of the enemy's reach.

The enemy had simply swung its axe down.

Strength only. With refined technique, it had no acquaintance.
I did not regret being cautious, but perhaps this fearsome appearance had made me too generous in my estimate.

Just as that thought came—

……<ruby>掠<rt>かす</rt></ruby>りもしない。
　敵は単純に、斧を打ち下ろしてきただけだった。

　その一撃も力任せで、精緻な技とは縁遠い。
　別に後悔はしていないが……少々、この恐ろしげな
見掛けの敵を警戒し過ぎたか。

　などと考えた瞬間だった。

en.html:
That had been an attack.
From the direction of the poke, no doubt who had done it.

But how? This information was missing.
The axe should have missed completely...

A hidden weapon? Some technique of the body?
What was the thing?

...Whatever it was, choosing caution apparently had not been a mistake.

ja.html:
今のは敵の攻撃だった。
　<ruby>つつかれた<rt>・・・・・</rt></ruby>方向を思えば、それは間違いない。

　だが手段が不明だった。
　斧の一撃は完全に躱していた筈……。

　何なのか。
　隠し武器か、それとも何らかの体術か。

　……いずれにしろ、慎重な対応を選んだのは誤りで
はなかったらしい。
